caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock with an ornate wooden case featuring a warm brown color and wood grain texture. The top section of the clock has a decorative, symmetrical pediment with scroll-like elements and three finials. The clock face is circular with a blue-gray background, black Roman numerals, and black clock hands, enclosed within an arched wooden frame. The body of the clock consists of a long, narrow central section with a panelled door, displaying swirling wood grain patterns, and a larger lower section with a similarly panelled design and elaborate edging, resting on molded feet. To the left of the clock, there is a boxed design schematic that shows front and side elevation diagrams of the clock with labeled measurements; to the right, there is another boxed area containing outline sketches of two stylistic clock hands. All elements are rendered on a cream background with fine red boundary lines marking the separate sections. The artist's signature, "ERNEST TOWERS JR. DEL. 01," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Grandfather's Clock
